column2: The left stick and D-pad (menu movement) always work.
Esc (back / pause), Enter (confirm), and the arrow keys (menu movement) always work.
Dragging with the left button is a flick (attacks in four directions and jump). A left click does the action assigned to Left Click in the table above.
Jump and Up Attack are the same move (on the ground you jump while attacking upward).
The same key cannot be assigned to multiple actions within the same context. You can use the same key for both run and menu controls.
